title: Association for Democratic Reforms v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Association for Democratic Reforms v. Union of India, (2024) INSC 113
content.holding: Struck down the Electoral Bond Scheme. Anonymous political donations violate the voter’s right to information under Article 19(1)(a).
